title: Exact source seam and declaration role replay
question: Can an opt-in source seam policy and declaration chain reproduce the genuine retained HanLP roles on the frozen definition without altering the control?
method: Authenticate the retained source through a read-only snapshot, reproduce both exact native requests, and replay the v2 role chain from the prior genuine HanLP reply in an in-memory producer envelope. Check the unaffected constant-density layout and refuse an alternate predicate as the naming witness.

inputs.role: Source and genuine native response replay over an in-memory producer fixture

outputs.role: Exact seam, role and refusal result with control

conclusion: The bounded versioned source seam and declaration role replay recovered the exact binomial definition on existing native evidence without moving the control. Release activation, native and detached settlement, independent qualification and retrieval eligibility remain open.
